title: A Study in Solution Models for SAT using the PBNF-transform
summary: In this article, we use the PBNF-transform, or Polynomial Boolean Normal Form, described earlier in two articles and now extended to higher arity, to solve Boolean satisfiability problems (SAT), which are part of the P versus NP problem. SAT consists of a statement of conjunctions of clauses, and in our SAT-solving models, we dualize the logical equations, inverting the problem by \emph{multiplying} letters (literals) in the transferred clauses, now phrases: $pqrs\cdots s_{\ell}$, and using a binary iterated composition based on \emph{adding polynomials} for the conjunctions in our solution…
